method: Source-specific official rule audits; stated terms are not independent payout confirmation. Candidate B2 penalty requires same product and contract version reconciliation. No completed 13-criterion score.

findings.fact: High-impact news executions within +/-5 minutes: news-derived profit credited up to 0.5% of starting account balance per payout cycle; excess profit removed. No breach. Pre-2026-04-27 accounts have older prohibition/profit-removal rules.
findings.consequence: On $100K, news profits above $500 per payout cycle are excluded.
findings.reason: Not automatically an asymmetric loss rule without explicit source on loss treatment.

findings.fact: Same FAQ states 15% threshold but also says best day must fall below 20%, and gives $1000 best day / $5000 total (20%) example; later text returns to 15%.
findings.consequence: A trader cannot reliably calculate payout eligibility from this article.
findings.reason: V5.2 material contradictory thresholds, pending contract cross-check.

findings.fact: First payout request 14 days after first funded trade, then 14 days after first trade following prior payout; minimum $100, crypto below $5000, Rise from $500; 24 business-hour processing guarantee advertised.
findings.consequence: Payout timing is eligibility based and guarantee is company-stated, not verified transfer evidence.

findings.program: One-Phase Lite/Pro, Two-Phase funded; Instant Funding Pro/Lite/Clarity
findings.fact: Without Major News Trading add-on, +/-4 minutes around high-impact events restrict affected instrument executions, including pending orders and SL/TP triggers; warning system up to two net-profit deductions and third violation breach on specified plans.
findings.consequence: Unintended stop execution during news can trigger a violation; product-specific warnings matter.
findings.reason: Clearly specified restriction is not itself vague or asymmetric without further evidence.

findings.fact: First strike (shared with Account Drawdown) reduces profit split to 50%; second strike closes account.
findings.consequence: Trading-news breach can permanently reduce split and later end account.
findings.reason: Explicit numeric rule, not automatically B2 deduction.

findings.fact: A newer October 2026 general terms PDF exists, alongside older June 2026 PDF linked in site data; current signed version and sanctions must be compared before B1 score.
findings.consequence: Do not audit contractual rights using outdated PDF.

findings.fact: 3% fee on each payout; crypto per-request maximum $1000, Rise no maximum; minimums differ. CFD standard every 14 days, Nano and Instant plans differ; Futures plans have buffers and caps.
findings.consequence: Displayed gross profit split overstates net trader proceeds unless processing fee included.

findings.fact: Guardian Shield triggered at 2% floating loss: first event permanently cuts profit split to 50%, second causes permanent account breach; evaluation phase is different.
findings.consequence: Risk-management intervention changes economics of funded account.
findings.reason: Explicit threshold; not inherently a vague discretionary rule.

findings.fact: One payout only, capped at $250 profit ($225 at 90% split); account permanently closes afterward. 15% best-day rule and five 0.5% profitable days.
findings.consequence: Cannot market this as a recurring funded payout product.

findings.fact: Best day below 20% for first payout, 25% second, 30% third onward; minimum profit goals and payout caps vary by size.
findings.consequence: Withdrawal eligibility requires sustained profit accumulation.
